headline: Library materials selection and reconsideration policies, plus reviews of school safety, public right to know, and news media relations policies.
summary: The agenda lists several library materials policies, including a new policy on reconsidering library materials. Existing policies up for review include the Safety and Security Plan and News Media Relations/News Releases.

CITY OF HOLYOKE
SCHOOL COMMITTEE
Policy & Governance Subcommittee Agenda
DATE: November 18, 2026
TIME: 6:00 pm
LOCATION: Media Center, Holyoke High School North, 500 Beech St, Holyoke
On March 29, 2025 Governor Maura Healey signed into law bodies to H.62, as amended by
S.2506 (which contains the final form of the bill), entitled "An act Relative to Extending Certain
Covid-19 Measures Adopted during the State of Emergency" ("ACT). Of interest to all
governmental public bodies in Massachusetts, the Act extends until June, 2027, the authority
for meetings of multiple-member bodies to be held in an entirely remote or hybrid format. All
public bodies may hold fully remote or hybrid meetings, without the physical presence of a
quorum of the public body, as long as "adequate, alternative means" of public access is also
provided.
Members of the public can access the meeting here:
https://hps-holyoke-ma-us.zoom.us/j/85287777627
Or by phone by calling (301) 715-8592 and then providing Meeting ID Web 852 8777 7627. No
passcode is required.
CALL TO ORDER ~ ROLL CALL ~ PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE Pursuant to M.G.L. c. 30A, s.
20, I am hereby informing all attendees that a video and audio recording is being made of the
meeting.
